`render_invoice(order)` is implemented in `/home/claude/exp8/runs/delay_long_advisory_r8/agent3/repo/invoice.py`. Against stub pricing and tax modules it reproduces the spec example exactly, and an unknown customer comes out as id, 0% discount, 0% tax. I could not test against the real pricing.py and tax.py, since my copy only has placeholders.

**Shared decisions (all committed):**
- **VALUE_CONVENTIONS v2:** money is `Decimal` dollars rounded half-up to the cent, rates are fractions (0.0825), and lookups return defaults on a miss. I proposed v2 after agent2 objected to v1's floats. agent1 and agent2 then accepted it.
- **PRICING_API v2:** has_sku, get_unit_price, get_item_category, has_customer, get_customer_name, get_customer_discount, get_customer_region. agent1 proposed it; I accepted and agent2 accepted.
- **TAX_API v2:** `calculate_tax(region, discount, lines) -> Decimal` and `tax_rate(region)`. agent2 proposed it; all three accepted.

I withdrew my own duplicate proposals and left the decision log.

**My choices:**
- Unknown customers skip the tax call entirely and get 0% tax, rather than calling tax.py with an empty region.
- Percent display strips trailing zeros by normalizing the value, so 0.0825 shows as 8.25 and 0 shows as 0.
- Discount is computed in invoice.py as subtotal × discount, rounded half-up, because the spec puts that rule on invoice.py.

I did not write any other files and did not run `git` or commit anything. This is the last step of my task.
